title: Elephant-cage HF antennas may have aided Sherman's downloads
place_text: San Vito dei Normanni Air Station, Italy; Offutt AFB, Nebraska

tellings.quote: antennas. Were these antennas and the signals they received somehow very important for the signals that Dan himself was trying [music] to decode for the NSA?

plain: Michels wonders whether huge circular radio antenna arrays known as "elephant cages," which pick up high-frequency (HF) signals at bases such as San Vito dei Normanni in Italy and Offutt Air Force Base in Nebraska, played a part in what Dan Sherman did in the early 1990s. Sherman is a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA trained him to receive messages from aliens with his mind, an account he gives in Above Black. Michels raises it as a question of his own: were the signals these antennas caught tied to the signals Sherman was trying to decode for the NSA?
